verdict.rationale: RevenueCat ships an in-product AI assistant (Rico), so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. However, no evidence shows that Rico or any other part of the product can connect to third-party MCP servers and use their tools. The RevenueCat MCP server and the AI Toolkit cover the opposite role: they let outside agents manage RevenueCat. They do not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
